jobs.description: Since our beginnings at Dr. Oetker, we have been breaking new ground. With pizza, cake, and desserts, as well as digital platforms and services - quality and an innovative spirit set us apart.What awaits you? It's up to you! At Dr. Oetker, you can actively shape the future - both yours and ours. We want to be part of something bigger. Don't you?JOIN THE TASTE.YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES- You will shape and drive the evolution of Dr. Oetker's enterprise-wide Process Management Framework. In this role, you will be responsible for governance, standards, methods and the target operating model to ensure consistent process management.- Your responsibilities include maintaining and further developing the process architecture. In addition, you will ensure that process documentation remains consistent, transparent and user-friendly.- You will also be responsible for providing tools, templates, guidelines and best practices, thereby empowering process owners and process stewards in their daily work.- With a focus on data and performance, you will analyse and promote data-driven process control. In doing so, you will support the use of KPI frameworks, process mining and process analytics.- Together with international stakeholders, you will further develop a global process management community. You will also design and conduct training sessions and enablement initiatives.- In addition, you will identify and drive the adoption of emerging technologies and innovative approaches to advance Process Management. Acting as a thought leader for Process Management, you will help define how Data, Processes, Analytics and AI work together to create business value across Dr. Oetker and advance Process Management through automation and AI-based solutions.WHAT YOU BRING- You have a bachelor's or master's degree in economics, business informatics, industrial engineering or a comparable qualification.- You have several years of professional experience in process management, operational excellence or business transformation.- You are proficient in business process management (BPM), process modelling, process governance and process architecture. You have already gained experience in process mining solutions such as SAP Signavio or Celonis.- In addition, you are familiar with data management, data governance, analytics and KPI-based process control. Ideally, you also have knowledge of digitalization, automation and AI applications.- You stand out thanks to your strong analytical and conceptual skills. You are characterized by strategic, entrepreneurial and solution-oriented thinking.- In addition, you are a strong communicator and possess excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills.- Your profile is completed by excellent teamwork, networking and community-building skills, along with a structured approach to work and very good English language skills.WHAT WE OFFER YOU- Attractive remuneration- Flexible work models & mobile work- 30 days of vacation plus special vacation at Christmas & New Year´s Eve- Onboarding and professional development opportunities- Excellent employee restaurant and discounts in the Dr. Oetker Shop- Events and celebrations- Sports, health and fitness offers- Pension plan, Sabbatical and JobRad- Employee Assistance Program (EAP), this offers professional support in all situations, such as assistance with childcare, finding au pairs, and advice on care services- Daycare cooperation for children, holiday childcare and laundry service

European Energy Exchange AGJobbeschreibungHello from EEX. As a leading commodity exchange in Europe, we develop, operate and connect the markets for global energy and commodity trading from Leipzig and 24 other worldwide offices. What’s the secret to our success? We are an expert team of dynamic individuals that drive forward exciting projects while sharing experiences, celebrating success and creating memories, together.We’re flexible! We’re happy to receive applications in English or German.The Market Surveillance Office of EEX monitors exchange trading to ensure the adherence to our rules and regulations, as well as national and international law. We are looking for a new senior legal advisor to join our Investigations Team. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues from different disciplines, providing legal expertise across a broad range of regulatory and surveillance-related matters and actively contributing to the integrity of energy markets.Your tasks:- Provide internal legal advice to the Market Surveillance team on regulatory and compliance-related matters- Draft legal opinions and written legal assessments on complex regulatory issues- Contribute legal analyses to investigation reports, including assessments of potential market abuse- Explain and represent the work and results of Market Surveillance vis-à-vis external supervisory and regulatory authorities- Monitor, analyse and interpret new and existing regulatory requirements (e.g. EU energy and financial market regulation)- Engage in professional exchange with legal experts at other exchanges, authorities and institutions regarding the implementation and application of applicable regulations- Support the continuous development of internal processes and legal standards within Market SurveillanceAfter all, we value the exchange of ideas, being there for each other and encouraging continuous improvement — we call it the exchange mindset.Your skills:- Fully qualified lawyer (e.g. German Volljurist or equivalent qualification from another jurisdiction)- Strong knowledge of regulatory law, ideally with a focus on energy markets, financial markets or capital markets regulation- Experience in working with regulatory authorities or in a regulated environment is highly desirable- Excellent analytical and drafting skills, with the ability to explain complex legal matters clearly and convincingly- Confident communication skills and the ability to represent legal positions in discussions with internal and external stakeholders- Proficiency in German and English (written and spoken) is requiredWhy join us?- Attractive salary package with many benefits including childcare facilities, meal allowance, job ticket, sport and recreational events- Flexible mobile working arrangements in a divers team- Personal development thanks to extensive further training opportunities- A place in a dynamic and international team within EEX Group and Deutsche Börse Group- A long-term perspective in the constantly growing and evolving energy- Bespoke onboarding plan

jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Vermessungsingenieur; Vermessungstechniker; BauvermesserStellenbeschreibung:Survey Technician (m/f/d), DresdenWe seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking. Woolpert is an award‑winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting‑edge technology to deliver exceptional client value, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, we embrace progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth. As part of Woolpert, Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company contributes deep geospatial expertise across Europe, supporting complex infrastructure, property, manufacturing, utilities, and natural‑environment projects through world‑class data capture, verification, and governance. Position OverviewDue to continued growth, we are seeking a Survey Technician - Construction & Engineering Surveying (m/f/d) to join our Special Projects Division based in Dresden, Germany.In this role, you will be involved in a long-term semiconductor construction project, supporting major building construction (Hochbau) and industrial construction (Industriebau) works. You will carry out a range of surveying activities including construction surveying, setting out, as-built surveys, and engineering surveying using the latest surveying, laser scanning, and geospatial technologies.This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career while contributing to one of Europe's most significant and technologically advanced construction projects.What You’ll Do- Carry out construction surveying activities on large-scale building and industrial construction projects.- Perform setting out and setting out works for structural, civil, and infrastructure elements.- Conduct as-built surveys to verify completed works and document project progress.- Deliver accurate engineering surveying services in accordance with project specifications and quality standards.- Work as part of a surveying team under the guidance of an experienced Geospatial Engineer.- Establish and densify survey control networks in line with industry best practices.- Operate modern surveying equipment, including Total Stations, GNSS receivers, laser scanners, imaging equipment, GPS systems, and data collectors.- Validate survey measurements using GNSS, Total Station, and laser scanning technologies.- Prepare and manage setting out data for upload to survey instruments.- Process and analyse survey data using software such as AutoCAD, StarNet, and Leica Cyclone.- Carry out regular calibration checks and maintenance of survey equipment and accessories.- Undertake additional project and surveying-related tasks as required.What You Will Bring- Completed vocational training, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Surveying, Geomatics, or a related field.- Experience in construction surveying, engineering surveying, setting out, or as-built surveying would be advantageous.- Previous experience working on construction sites within the building construction, industrial construction, or infrastructure sectors is desirable.- Understanding of surveying principles, methodologies, and geospatial data collection techniques.- Experience working with modern surveying equipment, including Total Stations and GNSS systems.- Experience with laser scanning technologies and related software (e.g. Leica Cyclone) would be beneficial.- Eligibility to work in Germany.- Good communication skills in English; German language skills would be advantageous.- Highly motivated, quality-focused, responsible, and able to work effectively as part of a team.Benefits You Will LoveAt Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company, you’ll join a collaborative and innovative team where your expertise makes a real impact. Our benefits include:- Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package aligned to your experience- Access to cutting‑edge geospatial technology and industry‑leading tools- Flexible working options designed to support work–life balance- Enhanced wellbeing support, including employee assistance initiatives- Opportunities within a growing, globally connected organisation through our partnership with Woolpert- Principal Programme: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.- Performance‑related bonus scheme that rewards your contribution- Fitness and Wellbeing reimbursement programme.Equal Employment OpportunityWoolpert is an equal‑opportunity employer committed to full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, and promote without regard to protected characteristics. For more information, see our EEO resources. Applicants requiring accommodation during recruitment may contact MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com (https://mailto:MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com)  Agency Notice Please do not contact any employee of Woolpert or its subsidiaries about this requisition. Agencies not engaged by the Woolpert Talent Acquisition Team will not be eligible for fee payment.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Building Information Modeling - BIM, 3-D-Laserscanning, GPS Global Positioning System, Projektmanagement, Ingenieurvermessung, Topografische Vermessung, Vermessung, CAD (Computer Aided Design)-Systeme anwenden, Geomatik, Baustellenvermessung, Topografie, Kartografie
